reason: Flat $20 for both of us is fairer than per-seat pricing, I'll give it that, but we already coordinate fine on free Slack plus voice notes and Notion. Moving everything over is a week of hassle to fix a problem we don't really feel.
objection: Slack's free plan already covers our chat, and half our talking is voice notes anyway. I don't see voice notes mentioned here, so the built-in chat wouldn't replace what we actually do. I'd be paying to rebuild a setup that costs us nothing.
would_change_my_mind: If it could replace Notion and our paid task app at the same time, so it actually cuts our bill instead of adding a line to it, and it handled voice notes in the chat.
